labels.label: risk
labels.reason: StrictMode now re-runs effects to check for restorable state, which changes development-mode behavior that applications may observe, such as effects running twice.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Assuming Symbols are always available removes fallbacks, so upgrading users on environments without Symbol support would break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the object-assign polyfill means applications relying on it in older environments must now supply their own polyfill.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The unstable_changedBits API is removed, so any code using it will break and must be migrated.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Components can now render undefined instead of throwing, a behavior change that can affect applications that depended on the previous error.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: useEffect resulting from discrete events like clicks is now flushed synchronously, a timing change that can alter application behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Suspense fallback={undefined} now behaves like null instead of being ignored, which changes rendering output for existing code.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Treating all lazy() resolving to the same component as equivalent changes reconciliation behavior, which may cause different mount or update results.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Console is no longer patched during first render, which changes what developers see in logs during that phase and can affect code relying on it.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Improving memory usage is an accurate note that requires no user action at this release.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Improved error messages when string coercion throws are informational and require no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Preferring setImmediate over MessageChannel changes scheduler timing in some environments, such as test runners or jsdom, which could affect deployments or tests.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: This is a pure bug fix for context propagation inside suspended trees that does not change correct behavior.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Removing the eager bailout in useReducer changes render behavior and may alter how often components re-render, so it is conservatively treated as a risk.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: This is a Safari-specific bug fix for setState being ignored when appending iframes and changes no correct behavior.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Fixing a crash when rendering ZonedDateTime is a pure bug fix with no required user action.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Fixing a crash when document is set to null in tests is a pure bug fix that changes no correct behavior.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Fixing onLoad not triggering with concurrent features is a pure bug fix.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Fixing a warning when a selector returns NaN is a pure warning fix with no behavior impact.

labels.label: noise
labels.reason: Fixing the generated license header is a metadata fix with no effect on application behavior.
